Online submission of information by the NEET PG 2017 qualified candidates for preparation of provisional merit list for MGIMS medical Post Graduate seats.
Candidates who have qualified the NEET PG 2017 examination and desirous for applying for the available seats of medical post graduate courses in MGIMS Sevagram, should submit information online on website i.e.
www.mgims.ac.in
upto
15/03/2017 by 5.00 pm.
The information submitted will be used for preparation of NEET PG 2017 MGIMS provisional merit list. The desirous candidates who will be submitting this information will only be considered for subsequent process of MGIMS admissions to available seats.
The Information Booklet for PG admission at MGIMS with rules and regulations will be made available on the website i.e.
www.mgims.ac.in
latest by
06/03/2017
.

paragraphs: Online submission of information by the NEET PG 2017 qualified candidates for preparation of provisional merit list for MGIMS medical Post Graduate seats.

Candidates who have qualified the NEET PG 2017 examination and desirous for applying for the available seats of medical post graduate courses in MGIMS Sevagram, should submit information online on website i.e. www.mgims.ac.in upto 15/03/2017 by 5.00 pm. The information submitted will be used for preparation of NEET PG 2017 MGIMS provisional merit list. The desirous candidates who will be submitting this information will only be considered for subsequent process of MGIMS admissions to available seats.
The Information Booklet for PG admission at MGIMS with rules and regulations will be made available on the website i.e. www.mgims.ac.in latest by 06/03/2017.

The window of online application will be closed on 15/03/2017 at 5.00 pm and no offline application will be accepted for further process of admissions. No separate or individual intimation will be sent at any time till the end of admission process. Eligibility/ Merit list of candidates shall be displayed on the MGIMS website by 31/03/2017.
